Fun with Python:

from mod import X

  imports the **value** of mod.X and binds it to a variable named X in the importing module

Which is great fun if you think you can change mod.X by

   X = X + 1

This is just local in your importing module, as mod.X is a separate variable.Well, well.🤦‍♀️ 😩
